entities.summary: Bradley Scott Oleson Lashinski is an American-born naturalized Spanish former professional basketball player. He is a 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m) tall point guard-shooting guard. His hometown of North Pole, Alaska, celebrates Brad Oleson Day every year on April 24.
